title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistant Quality
why_selected: The subject matter overlaps strongly with the search keywords (LLM applications, RAG, agent quality, evaluation frameworks), but the posting explicitly asks for 2+ years of industry experience and a record of shipped production systems, which an early-career candidate with internships only partly meets.

selected_requirements.text: 2+ years of industry experience in machine learning, applied AI, or software engineering with significant ML ownership.
Strong hands-on coding ability and a track record of shipping production systems, not just prototypes or research projects.
Experience in one or more of the following areas: LLM applications, NLP, search, retrieval, recommendations, evaluation frameworks, agent systems, or personalization.
Proficiency in common ML tooling and strong software engineering fundamentals in languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
Design evaluation, benchmarking, and monitoring loops to measure assistant quality, model quality, and end-to-end system performance.
Work across areas such as RAG, semantic search, recommendation-style systems, post-training or reinforcement learning, and agent orchestration where they materially improve product outcomes.

selection_hypothesis.note: Guesses made from the broad search keywords used to pick this posting, not from the profile itself. Confirm or correct them when the posting is tested locally.
likely_gaps: track record of shipping production systems
